Package models.academic

Class RecommendationLetter

java.lang.Object
models.academic.RecommendationLetter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RecommendationLetter extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an official recommendation letter written by a teacher for a student. This is a bonus feature for advanced system completeness.
